author: Iguanadon777
quote: The development team needs to be fired. GTA 5 had cool little interaction things like turning on the TV or drinking some beer, these were novelties that were fun to do when you were exploring the game. Now I have to waste my time after work doing chores instead of relaxing and having fun. They really could’ve made it completely optional, yet they chose to teach us a lesson. on the importance of doing these things like I’m a baby on a mature rated video game. GTA 5 was fun because you had the flexibility and freedom to do whatever you.
